2616 Hidden Valley Drive
Killeen, TX 76543
$159,900, 3 bed, 1.50 bath, 990 SF, MLS# 574344

A needle in a haystack, this one won't last long, this one will sell out fast! This charming 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath home is full of character, warmth and boasts a cozy, inviting atmosphere throughout. This home also features ceramic tiles all over the house and beautiful original details that add charm and personality. One of the most interesting and indisputable attributes of this house is the back yard, perfect for unwinding after a long day. Imagine sipping your morning coffee or hosting summer barbecues in this tranquil, secluded space. The lush greenery and serene atmosphere make this backyard a true haven. This property is located in an established, well-maintained neighborhood and is move-in ready. Enjoy the convenience of being close to local shops, gas stations, schools, restaurants, and parks. It is also just 2 miles away from the Fort Cavazos Warrior Way Gate, about 5 minutes driving distance. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or looking to downsize, this property has everything you need for comfortable living.

1 full bath, 1 half bath
